Six programmes · a sector in focus 3–4 times a year

Programmes

ADD starts as a district without walls: a calendar of programmes held in member studios and partner venues across Abuja. Six programmes, each bringing at least three pillars together.

See the 2027 calendarHow the year works ↓

All programmes

01

ADD Open Studios

A walking or driving trail through member studios and showrooms, with a printed and digital map.

How often
Monthly or every two months
Starting
First trail: February 2027
02

ADD Salon

Intimate talk-and-dinner evenings pairing an architect, a fashion designer and a maker on one theme.

How often
Monthly
Starting
First Salon: January 2027
03

ADD Craft Exchange

Residencies and commissions pairing heritage artisans with contemporary designers. The results are exhibited and sold.

How often
Twice a year
Starting
Announced February 2027
04

ADD Material Library

A growing collection of Nigerian materials, finishes and textiles for architects and interior designers to specify.

How often
Ongoing
Starting
Starts as a pop-up in 2027
05

ADD Pop-up Showroom

A curated, shoppable exhibition of member work in a borrowed or partner space.

How often
Every quarter
Starting
First showroom: March 2027
06

ADD Week

The flagship annual festival: exhibitions, talks, open studios, a fashion presentation and international guests.

How often
Every year
Starting
First edition: late 2027

One sector per quarter

3–4 times a year

Three or four times a year, roughly once a quarter, ADD's calendar puts one of the six sectors in focus. Sectors that don't get a turn one year lead the next.

Host, sponsor or partner

Bring a programme to your space.

Members host Open Studios stops and Salons in their own studios. Partners lend venues and sponsor programmes, especially ADD Week.
